description.narrative:
The primary beneficiaries of this project are 750 Households or consist of 3,975 internally displaced persons (IDPs), returnees andhosted communities residing in six undesignated sites in Gaza governorate who currently lack access to any functioning sanitation infrastructure. Within this population, the most vulnerable groups including children, women, girls, elderly, and PWDs are identifiedas priority beneficiaries.
The project will ensure that all activities are designed and implemented according to the principles ofAge, Gender, and Diversity (AGD) mainstreaming, and that the specific needs and voices of women, girls, and marginalized groups areintegrated throughout the project cycle.
Objective: Vulnerable populations in underserved displacement sites, including IDPs, returnees and hosted communities, have lived in environmentally healthy conditions through provision of sanitation services
Output 1: Critical WASH facilities in IDPs sites are repaired, cleaned and functional to support continued access to safe and essential WASH services.
Activity 1.1: Launching the project and coordination with stakeholders Activity 1.2: Technical assessment of the targeted sites.
Activity 1.3: Establishment and management of the wastewater drainage system in the targeted shelters
Activity 1.4: Collect and transfer accumulated solid waste and wastewater
Output 2: IDPs, returnees and hosted communities in unserved sites engage in community-based hygiene promotion and decision-making processes
Activity 2.1: Promote hygienic behaviors and community engagement, protection mainstreaming, in WASH interventions through using the community-based volunteers’ approach
Activity 2.2: Carry out community cleaning companies using the distributed cleaning tools and Consumables to decrease the public health risks
Activity 2.2: Carryout community-led initiatives
Activity 2.3: Distribution of Family Hygiene Kits or other HH WASH NFIs through UNICEF and IOM piplines

participating-org.narrative: The Palestinian Environmental Friends Association is a non-profit organization (Nongovernmental Organization). It was establishmentin 1998 by a group of Palestinian experts to meet the demand needed in the field of the environment and natural resources.The establishment of PEF enables environmental friends all over the world to cooperate neglecting geological and political constrains to stopthe negative impacts on the environment. Together, we create a universal free from pollution, sustainable and suitable for new generations. PEF practiced projects almost all over Gaza Strip. The projects activities mainly covered the following areas: Water and wastewater, public health, global warming, infrastructure and capacity building activities, compost production, solid wastes and awareness programs. The association aim is to share in improving the environmental situation in the Palestinian territories, also, to protect the local environment, and public health natural resources from pollution and mining. Public awareness <(>&<)> environmental education is one of the organization aims to have sustainable and well-managed natural resources in addition of rehabilitation of Water and Sewerage Infrastructure in Northern Gaza Governorate . PEF aims to have a wide range ofcooperation with local, regional and international organizations and individuals share its aims and activities
